name: data-table-expandable-rows
title: Data table: Expandable rows
description: Rows that open in place to show an invoice's line items, totals and payment details.
author: DressCode UI <https://dresscodeui.com>

// Invoices that open in place: the chevron shows an invoice's line items, totals and payment details // under its row, without leaving the list. The header chevron (or Expand all) opens every row on the page. "use client" import type { ColumnDef, Row } from "@tanstack/react-table" import { ChevronsDownUpIcon, ChevronsUpDownIcon, CircleAlertIcon, CircleCheckIcon, ClockIcon, DownloadIcon, ExternalLinkIcon, FilePenLineIcon } from "lucide-react" import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge" import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button" import { Table, TableBody, TableCell, TableFooter, TableHead, TableHeader, TableRow } from "@/components/ui/table" import { DataTable, expandColumn } from "@/components/ui/data-table" import { DataTableColumnHeader } from "@/components/ui/data-table-column-header" type Status = "Paid" | "Due" | "Overdue" | "Draft" type LineItem = { description: string; qty: number; unit: string; rate: number } type Invoice = { id: string client: string email: string issued: string due: string status: Status items: LineItem[] subtotal: number tax: number total: number paidOn?: string } const CLIENTS = [ ["Fernwood Studio", "mara@fernwood.studio"], ["Kato & Lee", "ken@katolee.com"], ["Juniper Labs", "theo@juniperlabs.dev"], ["Ola Bakery", "hello@olabakery.com"], ["Pellucid Health", "accounts@pellucid.health"], ["Alder Coffee", "sam@aldercoffee.com"], ["Mossgrove Architects", "paul@mossgrove.co.uk"], ["Saltmarsh Films", "nadia@saltmarsh.film"], ["Tidewater Co.", "hana@tidewater.co"], ["Quill & Ink", "bea@quillandink.co"], ] as const // What the studio sells: [description, unit, rate, how many of the unit an invoice usually has]. const SERVICES: [string, string, number, number[]][] = [ ["Brand strategy workshop", "day", 1200, [1, 2]], ["Logo and identity system", "project", 3800, [1]], ["Website design", "hour", 110, [12, 18, 24]], ["Front-end build", "hour", 95, [16, 20, 32]], ["Copywriting", "hour", 85, [4, 6, 10]], ["Product photography", "half day", 650, [1, 2]], ["Monthly design retainer", "month", 1500, [1]], ["Hosting and maintenance", "month", 120, [1, 3]], ["Illustration set", "set", 480, [1, 2]], ["Print production", "batch", 340, [1, 2]], ] const DAY = 86_400_000 const TODAY = Date.UTC(2026, 10, 24) const TAX_RATE = 0.08 const MONTHS = ["Jan", "Feb", "Mar", "Apr", "May", "Jun", "Jul", "Aug", "Sep", "Oct", "Nov", "Dec"] const iso = (t: number) => new Date(t).toISOString().slice(0, 10) const formatDate = (d: string) => `${MONTHS[Number(d.slice(5, 7)) - 1]} ${Number(d.slice(8, 10))}, ${d.slice(0, 4)}` const usd = new Intl.NumberFormat("en-US", { style: "currency", currency: "USD" }) const INVOICES: Invoice[] = Array.from({ length: 30 }, (_, i) => { const [client, email] = CLIENTS[(i * 7 + 3) % CLIENTS.length] const issuedAt = TODAY - (i * 4 + (i % 3)) * DAY const dueAt = issuedAt + [14, 30, 30, 7][i % 4] * DAY const status: Status = i < 2 ? "Draft" : dueAt >= TODAY ? "Due" : i % 6 === 1 ? "Overdue" : "Paid" const items = Array.from({ length: 1 + ((i * 5 + 1) % 4) }, (_, k): LineItem => { const [description, unit, rate, qtys] = SERVICES[(i * 3 + k * 7) % SERVICES.length] return { description, unit, rate, qty: qtys[(i + k) % qtys.length] } }) const subtotal = items.reduce((s, it) => s + it.qty * it.rate, 0) const tax = Math.round(subtotal * TAX_RATE * 100) / 100 const paidOn = status === "Paid" ? iso(dueAt - ((i * 3) % 9) * DAY) : undefined return { id: `INV-${1030 - i}`, client, email, issued: iso(issuedAt), due: iso(dueAt), status, items, subtotal, tax, total: subtotal + tax, paidOn } }) const quantity = (item: LineItem) => `${item.qty} ${item.qty === 1 ? item.unit : item.unit === "half day" ? "half days" : `${item.unit}s`}` const STATUS: Record; variant: "secondary" | "outline" | "destructive" }> = { Overdue: { icon: CircleAlertIcon, variant: "destructive" }, Due: { icon: ClockIcon, variant: "outline" }, Draft: { icon: FilePenLineIcon, variant: "outline" }, Paid: { icon: CircleCheckIcon, variant: "secondary" }, } const columns: ColumnDef[] = [ expandColumn({ label: (row) => row.original.id }), { accessorKey: "id", meta: { label: "Invoice" }, header: ({ column }) => , cell: ({ row }) => {row.original.id}, }, { accessorKey: "client", meta: { label: "Client" }, header: ({ column }) => , cell: ({ row }) => {row.original.client}, }, { accessorKey: "issued", meta: { label: "Issued" }, header: ({ column }) => , cell: ({ row }) => {formatDate(row.original.issued)}, }, { accessorKey: "status", meta: { label: "Status" }, header: ({ column }) => , cell: ({ row }) => { const { icon: Icon, variant } = STATUS[row.original.status] return ( {row.original.status} ) }, }, { id: "items", accessorFn: (row) => row.items.length, meta: { label: "Line items", align: "right" }, header: ({ column }) => , cell: ({ row }) => {row.original.items.length}, }, { accessorKey: "total", meta: { label: "Total", align: "right" }, header: ({ column }) => , cell: ({ row }) => {usd.format(row.original.total)}, }, ] function InvoiceDetails({ row }: { row: Row }) { const invoice = row.original const payment = invoice.status === "Paid" ? `Paid ${formatDate(invoice.paidOn!)} by bank transfer` : invoice.status === "Overdue" ? `${Math.round((TODAY - Date.parse(invoice.due)) / DAY)} days late, reminder sent Nov 20` : invoice.status === "Draft" ? "Not sent yet" : `Due ${formatDate(invoice.due)}` // A size container: the details take the table's width instead of stretching it. return (
Description Qty Rate Amount {invoice.items.map((item) => ( {item.description} {/* Narrow details: quantity and rate under the description instead of in columns. */} {quantity(item)} × {usd.format(item.rate)} {quantity(item)} {usd.format(item.rate)} {usd.format(item.qty * item.rate)} ))} Subtotal {usd.format(invoice.subtotal)} Sales tax ({TAX_RATE * 100}%) {usd.format(invoice.tax)} Total {usd.format(invoice.total)}
Billed to
{invoice.client} {invoice.email}
Issued
{formatDate(invoice.issued)}
Payment
{payment}
) } export default function DataTableExpandableRows() { return (
